config.comment.addtradepair: Press while hovering over a trade in the villager screen to add it as a trade pair
config.comment.enabled: Trade with villagers in range when enabled
config.comment.trademode: Trade mode: Static Trade, Moving Trade, Void Trade
config.comment.tradeexecutormode: Trade executor strategy: USE (default, reads offer.getUses() directly; simpler but relies on the local click simulation) or OUTPUT_SLOT (does not read offer uses; snapshot-based remaining)
config.comment.containeriointerval: Min ticks between container operations (0 = check every tick)
config.comment.containerioidleinterval: Ticks to wait when no container operation is needed
config.comment.trapchestdelay: Ticks to keep the trapped chest screen open after opening (stabilizes the redstone signal and leaves time for the mechanism to react); shared by container IO and the void return trigger
config.comment.opentimeout: Timeout ticks waiting for a screen to open after interacting (trade screen, container screen, or return trigger block); shared by all screen-open waits
config.comment.tasktimeout: Max ticks a single task may run before it is force-aborted and control returns to idle decisions (a failed void return trigger is retried next cycle). Prevents stuck states (e.g. trade offers never syncing). 0 = disabled. Raise if Void Teleport Timeout or Void Unload Delay is set above this value
config.comment.debughud: Show the debug HUD overlay with live trade status and counters (small corner panel with a semi-transparent background; hidden while a screen is open)
config.comment.debughudposition: Screen corner where the debug HUD is drawn
config.comment.idlescaninterval: Ticks to reuse the container IO scan result before rescanning (lower = fresher container detection, higher = less CPU). Finishing any task always rescans immediately.
config.comment.containerreach: Max distance in blocks to a container for container IO to trigger (the server ignores clicks beyond ~4.5 blocks, so higher values may not work).
config.comment.outputmovecap: Maximum item stacks moved in a single output container-IO operation (999 = move all matching stacks)
config.comment.tradecachettl: Villagers with no executable matching offer skip screen-opening for this long before their trades are re-checked (3000 ticks = 2.5 min; 0 = disable the cache entirely). Matched villagers are never skipped (re-learned each session)
config.comment.tradeinterval: Min ticks between trade rounds in static mode (100 ticks = 5 seconds)
config.comment.movingrangemultiplier: Multiplier applied to the villager scan range in moving mode (used for both the scan radius and the processed-villager invalidation threshold); 1.5 = 1.5x the base range
config.comment.movinginteractrange: Max distance (blocks) for villager candidates to be dispatched in moving mode (server entity-interaction limit is 6 blocks: AABB-to-eye < 6.0; raise if moving players fail to interact)
config.comment.movingstarvationaginginte: Ticks after which an unserved candidate in range gains +1 starvation (resident targets never leave range, so aging is their only hunger growth path; 3 cycles beat the container bonus)
config.comment.movingstarvationhintthres: Starvation threshold: targets with hunger >= this value trigger a one-time in-game hint (check your movement path); running tasks yield to hungrier targets in interaction range
config.comment.voidteleporttimeout: Timeout ticks waiting for the villager to disappear (player teleport) after the trade screen opened (100 ticks = 5 seconds); close the screen and skip the villager when it expires; 0 = wait indefinitely
config.comment.voidunloaddelay: Ticks to wait after the villager disappears (player teleport) before trading, so the server finishes unloading the villager's chunk and trade counts are not persisted to the villager (20 ticks = 1 second; 0 = trade immediately; raise if trades keep being exhausted)
config.comment.voidreturntype: Void-mode block type used to teleport the player back after a trade round: None (disabled), Trapped Chest, Button, Lever
config.comment.voidreturnpos: Position of the return trigger block as "x y z" (e.g. -13 60 -1)
config.comment.voidreturnstrict: Strictly validate that the block type matches the return trigger block type; mismatches are skipped with a warning (default off = only check block existence and distance)
config.comment.voidreturndim: Dimension (registry id) where the void return trigger block is located, e.g. minecraft:overworld. Empty = any dimension
config.comment.grabcontainercoordinate: Press to grab the container at your feet (position + current dimension) and open the settings GUI in grab mode: every grab button turns into a flashing save button - click one to write the grabbed position into that record; closing the GUI abandons the grab
config.comment.paireditgive: Click [Grab Give] to use the item in hand
config.comment.paireditgive2: Optional second give item for 2-for-1 trades (leave empty for single-cost pairs)
config.comment.paireditget: Click [Grab Get] to use the item in hand
config.comment.paireditlimit: Max amount of the FIRST give item per trade (the 2nd give item is not price-adjusted and has no limit)
